name: Heelbone Torment
description: Plant the feet and send the whole body weight and qi into a single straight punch.

name: Meridian Elbow
description: Throw a light jab to learn the opponent's reach and draw their hands up.

name: Immovable Fist
description: Hold the forearm vertical before the body so heavy blows break against the bone.

name: Torrent Palm
description: Weave the head and shoulders under a swing and step inside the arm.

name: Mightknee
description: Roll two elbows from one hip turn to strike jaw and ribs in a row.

name: Quelling Ulna
description: Hook the shoulder under the arm and tip the opponent onto the heel of the back.

name: Rupturing Vessel Knee
description: Gather qi along the arm for three beats and release a crossing punch that breaks the guard.

name: Shin Torment
description: Drive a looping fist beneath the ribs with qi to reach the organs behind the cover.

name: Thornfist
description: Move the grip from wrist to forearm to elbow as the opponent wriggles so the control is never lost.

name: Subduing Shoulder
description: Lean the elbow into the chest of a downed opponent and settle all the weight on it.

name: Manacling Grapple
description: Wrap the legs around neck and arm and squeeze until the opponent stops struggling.

name: Pinfall Cuirass
description: Press a charged thumb into the wrist and bring the hand to the floor.

name: Torrent Knuckle
description: Twist the held limb against the pinning fingers and rip it clear.

name: Thorn Throw
description: Pour qi through the joined hands so the hold hardens against a surge of strength.

name: Palmpounce
description: Release one hold and take the next in a single slide so the opponent finds no gap.

name: Toxinsweep
description: Shatter a clinch by dropping the head and driving the shoulder into the chest.

name: Ponderous Knuckle
description: Press down on the opponent's hips through the hold until their legs can no longer push.

name: Exact Shoulder
description: Watch the opponent's hips and heels to learn where the weight rests and which foot is free.

name: Tempered Clinch
description: Touch the lead heel with a short kick to test the stance before committing.

name: Annealed Hip
description: Check a low kick with the shin so the bone meets the opponent's shin and turns the leg.

name: Vesselfist
description: Tilt away from a straight blow and slip down the opponent's flank.

name: Rumble Shin
description: Sweep the weighted foot out with a qi-charged hook to topple the whole stance.

name: Rumblefist
description: Drive both palms into the shoulders when the feet are crossed to stagger them.

name: Dominating Palm
description: Hook the back foot as the opponent crosses their feet and let them fall by their own motion.

name: Hipcuirass
description: Plant a knee against the opponent's thigh to pin the leg to the floor.

name: Iron Hip
description: Press the open palm slowly into the chest to carry qi into the body before the shock.

name: Might Elbow
description: Jab the sternum with a tight fist so the qi rings in the lungs.

name: Grinding Fist
description: Drive a short hook under the ribs to empty the breath and bend the opponent forward.

name: Unshaken Hip
description: Wrap the arms in a thin field of qi so outside force is spread across the whole forearm.

name: Ulnaspurt
description: Slide forward on a bent knee to get beneath the guard and inside the opponent's reach.

name: Sweeptorment
description: Gather qi in the knuckles for several beats before a punch that jars the bone itself.

name: Glint Sweep
description: Drive a fist into the opponent's back along the spine so the qi travels the length of the trunk.

name: Kneetorment
description: Send a short, sharp palm that passes qi straight through the guard to the organs beneath.

name: Hastening Ulna
description: Step so one attacker stands between you and the others and cannot be flanked.

name: Unmaking Pinfall
description: Drive a shoulder into a ring of men to push a lane through them.

name: Mighthip
description: Throw an elbow behind without turning to drive off an attacker who grips from the back.

name: Toxinpalm
description: Hurl one opponent into those behind him to cut off their rush.

name: Granite Knee
description: Set the back against a solid object and guard the front with both arms.

name: Auraclinch
description: Weave between grasping hands, using qi in the feet to keep the pace.

name: Equipoise Elbow
description: Burst outward from several grips together with a sharp surge of qi.

name: Slag Grapple
description: Spin a low kick in a full circle to drive back those pressing on all sides.

name: Hour Palm
description: Cut down one opponent with a fast run of strikes and move on before the others close.

name: Drubbing Knee
description: Strike with both palms together, one a beat behind the other, to break the guard in two stages.

name: Vessel Knuckle
description: Hold both palms up before the face so a blow meets a double cover.

name: Silt Chokehold
description: Glide forward on the lead foot behind a rising palm to close the space.

name: Resilient Shin
description: Turn an incoming strike aside with a circling palm like a stream curving round a stone.

name: Thornulna
description: Snatch the opponent's wrist with a hooked hand and pull them onto the second palm.

name: Vesselsweep
description: Press one palm in as the other withdraws, repeating so qi rolls into the chest in waves.

name: Thorn Sweep
description: Press the opponent's hand against their own chest with one palm and strike with the other.

name: Lotfist
description: Throw a pair of palms, then a second pair mirrored on the other side, in a quick rhythm.

name: Meridian Shoulder
description: Seize the shoulder and arm from above with hooked fingers and hold the opponent in place.

name: Rumbleclinch
description: Drop the weight onto the gripped shoulder and bring the opponent down.

name: Torrent Shin
description: Circle the forearms to wipe a punch off the line and keep both hands near the face.

name: Whipping Sweep
description: Step in on a downward angle and close on the opponent's arms.

name: Vesselelbow
description: Spread the opponent's arm wide across the thigh and lean on the elbow.

name: Rumble Ulna
description: Lift the opponent over the hip in a high arc and release at the peak.

name: Gyveelbow
description: Hold the opponent's wrists in each hand and force them out and down.

name: Remnant Fist
description: Mark the opponent's shoulders and weight from above with a still gaze to choose the throw.

name: Might Heelbone
description: Push a smooth palm forward like a current to carry qi into the chest.

name: Nimbus Shoulder
description: Gather the arms in a bowl before the chest so the blow is drawn in and spent.

name: Racing Heelbone
description: Turn in a small circle on the front foot to let a charge pass by.

name: Gyve Knuckle
description: Run the palm along the opponent's arm and lock the wrist as it arrives.

name: Rumble Elbow
description: Strike the ribs with one hand while the second drives a counter-current to the neck.

name: Ponderous Heelbone
description: Bend the elbow and shoulder together so qi settles into the joints and the hold cannot be shaken.

name: Unbroken Knee
description: Release stored qi outward from the guard to send the attacker's force back along its path.

name: Granite Chokehold
description: Join two strikes from different sides at one point on the chest.

name: Nimbus Fist
description: Press the dantian with the heel of the hand to still the opponent's qi flow.

name: Grapple Torment
description: Pour qi through the palm into the body in a rush that breaks the opponent's cover.

name: Gust Grapple
description: Step in with a choice of hip throw or leg reap ready.

name: Subduing Palm
description: Lift the opponent over the hip along a rising arc and drive them down on the shoulder.

name: Mayhem Throw
description: Sweep both of the opponent's legs one after the other so they cannot catch the fall.

name: Chime Palm
description: Pull the attacking arm along its line and turn the body so the force runs past.

name: Iron Elbow
description: Hold the arms wide and high to cover the head and flanks while the feet reposition.

name: Kneeplating
description: Begin a hip throw and, as the opponent braces, switch to a leg reap with qi in the feet.

name: Toxin Knuckle
description: Lift the opponent clear of the ground in a bowl hold and set them down hard.

name: Hour Ulna
description: Throw the opponent and strike the chest on the way down with the free hand.

name: Transfixing Sweep
description: Sweep the low leg around in a wide arc to catch the ankles of every attacker nearby.

name: Compressing Sweep
description: Take a firm hold on the opponent's shoulder and set the stance along one bearing.

name: Toxin Ulna
description: Lean the whole body into the opponent like a gust and drop them to the ground.

name: Silt Throw
description: Step out wide on the open ground to give a charging opponent no ground to catch.

name: Adamant Hip
description: Slip the forearm along the arm of the opponent and turn the blow into the air.

name: Meridian Pinfall
description: Keep the opponent pinned to the ground with a straight arm, steady as an oath once spoken.

name: Shinspurt
description: Roll sideways and rise on the other side of the opponent with the guard up.

name: Shin Cloak
description: Drive the opponent to the edge of the practice ring and throw them over the line.

name: Fistplating
description: Lean the whole weight into the opponent and hold them under a pressure that grows steady.

name: Lambasting Pinfall
description: Stride forward on the wind and throw a long punch from the shoulder.

name: Blazepalm
description: Throw three light jabs in quick time like gusts against a shuttered window.

name: Hoarfrost Heelbone
description: Keep both forearms on one bearing before the face so strikes arrive along a known line.

name: Siltpalm
description: Step in a rush with the rear foot to close the gap like a gust.

name: Cleaving Chokehold
description: Drive the cross into an advancing opponent so their own speed adds to the hit.

name: Hip Assault
description: Gather qi along the rising arm and send an uppercut that lifts the opponent from the ground.

name: Iron Shoulder
description: Drive the elbow down to the collarbone as the opponent leans into a punch.

name: Equipoise Knee
description: Turn the forearm across an incoming blow and push it out and away.

name: Funneling Vessel Pinfall
description: Chase a retreating opponent with a run of punches that never lets them settle.

name: Staunch Fist
description: Hold the open hand before the chest and keep it there as a promise that no blow will pass.

name: Aurafist
description: Thrust the open palm into the chest with qi gathered behind it like a gust.

name: Rejuvenating Elbow
description: Lay a light palm on the opponent's wrist to read the force and direction of their intent.

name: Torrent Heelbone
description: Turn the opponent's attack on a bearing taken by the palm and send it past the body.

name: Granite Pinfall
description: Step freely past the opponent's guard on open ground with no obstruction to the move.

name: Cleaving Fist
description: Chop the edge of the palm onto the neck from a high bearing.

name: Quelling Palm
description: Wrap the arm about the opponent's and turn the hips so they fall in the line of the wind.

name: Forged Shoulder
description: Hold the palm against the body and release qi slowly so it passes through to the organs beneath.

name: Dominating Knee
description: Press the open palm against the dantian and hold it still until the opponent yields.

name: Facet Ulna
description: Spread the toes and sink the stance so the feet hold on loose sand and slick planks.

name: Compressing Knuckle
description: Draw the opponent forward by the arm and drop them as their weight carries past the foot.

name: Careening Shin
description: Drag the opponent's arm across the body and slip behind them as they tilt.

name: Enduring Fist
description: Flick both hands upward to turn aside a blow and blind the eyes with wet hands.

name: Gyveknee
description: Lock the arms around the opponent's body and settle the hips as a ship settles on its anchor.

name: Aura Hip
description: Roll through a throw and come up with the opponent's back exposed.

name: Nimbusshin
description: Lift the opponent on the rising swell of the hips and tip them over the shoulder.

name: Clinchthrash
description: Carry the opponent down in a throw that drives the hip into the ribs on landing.

name: Mayhem Grapple
description: Sweep the opponent's feet as they correct for a lurch of the ground beneath them.

name: Clinch Plating
description: Hold the pin along a fixed bearing to the shore until the opponent yields.
